messages.subject: CLE: Commercial property update seminar - 9 December
messages.plaintextBody:
Hello both,

A reminder that the firm's quarterly commercial property CLE seminar (this quarter: SDLT changes and the latest on the Building Safety Act) is on Tuesday 9 December, 4-6pm in the Bishopsgate boardroom, drinks after. Please RSVP to me by Friday for catering.

Donna
